periods.time: During Ikki's week-long coma after the Toka fight

name.zh: 〈红莲皇女〉VS〈深海魔女〉伴侣资格测验
name.en: Stella vs Shizuku Partner Qualification Test

periods.location: Hagun infirmary and Shizuku/Alice dorm room
periods.summary: Shizuku tests whether Stella is worthy to be Ikki's partner through cleaning, cooking and a direct question about loving Ikki.
periods.cause: After Ikki and Stella's relationship becomes public, Shizuku falls into despair; Alice reframes her family role as objectively judging Stella's suitability.
periods.process: Shizuku catches Stella trying to kiss unconscious Ikki, forces her into a test, sabotages the room-cleaning and cooking tasks, and asks whether Stella will love Ikki more than Shizuku and make him happy.
periods.outcome: Stella passes through competence, improvisation and sincerity; Shizuku says Ikki is in Stella's care, but Stella later pretends the test failed so Shizuku can continue challenging her without forcing herself to abandon her feelings.
periods.significance: A major turning point in Stella and Shizuku's relationship: Shizuku recognizes Stella's worth while Stella recognizes Shizuku's pain.
